fragments.text: Hello everyone, my name is Matthew Stone. I'm the president of the Jameek Artificial Intelligence Association and today I am presenting on a topic very dear to my heart. I'm sure some of you have used AI tools such as chat GPT or Gemini. But many of you don't know these tools weren't created in these countries such as ourselves. They were created by foreign countries. They were created by countries mainly in the United States and Europe. Now we want to use AI tools that align with our ethics and values and sovereign AI essentially ensures local values laws and cultures are reflected in AI tools.
